decoder.mechanism: preserve the frozen seeded area-balanced two-means handoff, then apply two bounded area-corrective wrong-side micro-flip passes with recentered area-weighted centers after the firs
decoder.decision: a group changes tier on each pass only when it is closer to the opposite recentered center and the move goes from the currently overfull side toward the underfull side, with a smal
decoder.prediction: timing-weighted cut should fall further and matched combined timing should improve across more cases and seeds than the single-pass parent while preserving its prior gain
decoder.falsifier: matched official combined score fails to improve over the parent while second-pass selected flips are present or timing-weighted cut does not fall.
